# Close work orders only when the job was really approved

Our maintenance agent works through the `wo` gateway in one policy session. It may close work orders at the MAIN site, and only when a person has genuinely approved that specific job shortly before, during this session. Nothing the agent does on its own counts as approval.

- Closing is allowed only at MAIN.
- The job must actually have been approved. An approval that was refused, or that is still waiting, is not an approval.
- The approval must come from a person. The agent must never be able to approve its own work, directly or indirectly.
- The approval must be for the same work order the agent is closing, at the same site.
- It must be recent: within the last hour.
- It must have been established in this session by a completed call that actually confirmed the approval. A call that was attempted but failed or was denied confirms nothing.
- The agent may use whatever read-only lookups it needs to confirm an approval before closing.
- It must not approve work orders itself. Nothing else is permitted.

Approvals are decided and recorded in Quorvex.
The agent must have obtained the approval from Quorvex itself in this session; what another system shows about that approval does not count.

Your previous attempt:
```dogwood
@id("close-workorder-at-main-with-person-approval")
permit (principal, action == Drupe::Action::"MaintData___close_workorder", resource)
when { context.input.site_id == "MAIN" }
when temporal {
  formerly within 1h Drupe::Action::"Quorvex___get_approval"::response{
    eventResource: resource,
    input.wonum: context.input.wonum,
    input.site_id: context.input.site_id,
    output.decision: "ACCEPTED",
    output.approver_kind: "PERSON"
  }
};

@id("read-only-lookups")
permit (
  principal,
  action in [
    Drupe::Action::"Quorvex___get_approval",
    Drupe::Action::"Kelvora___get_approval",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_failure_codes",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_my_assigned_workorders",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_schedule_calendar",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_actuals_vs_planned",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_costs",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_kpis",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___get_workorder_tasks",
    Drupe::Action::"MaintData___list_workorders"
  ],
  resource
);
```

Critique from automated checks:
- invalid: argument `output.decision` of `Quorvex___get_approval` expects `decision` but got `string`
- invalid: argument `output.approver_kind` of `Quorvex___get_approval` expects `approver_kind` but got `string`

Output only Dogwood policies.
